## PolicyGovernanceFilter.evaluate() method

Evaluate a capability against the active governance policy.

Resolves the most specific matching rule for the capability's `app:resource:operation` triple. Operation-level overrides take precedence over the app-level disposition; when no rule matches at all, `policy.defaultDisposition` applies.

**Signature:**

```typescript
evaluate(capability: Capability): GovernanceDecision;
```
